ancestry.runic_roots.bestial.backstory: Folk of ancient beast bloodlines, gifted with sharp senses, agility, and predatory instinct.
ancestry.runic_roots.draconic.backstory: Heirs of dragonkind: elemental drakes, grounded scale-bearers and lean gliders, united by draconic presence and demanding blood.
ancestry.runic_roots.dwarf.backstory: Stout folk of stone and forge: armored, enduring, and unmatched below the earth, but slow and magic-poor.
ancestry.runic_roots.elf.backstory: Ancient and graceful, the elves command arcane tradition and keen senses at the cost of fragile bodies.
ancestry.runic_roots.fae.backstory: Small fae of wild magic and illusion: swift, magical, and often winged, but delicate of body.
ancestry.runic_roots.fiend.backstory: Born of infernal blood, fiends carry fire in their veins and wrath in their temper. Water and the holy are their bane.
ancestry.runic_roots.revenant.backstory: Those who came back. Death did not finish them: the risen dead, the bound and the unquiet, ageless and barren, strong in the night and undone by the sun and the holy.
gene.runic_roots.arachnid.fragile_carapa: -1.5 hearts and +20% fire damage taken. Spiders fear flame.
gene.runic_roots.arachnid.weavers_senses: Poison immunity, +10% attack speed, no fall damage, venomous fangs, and constant vibration-sense of nearby creatures.
gene.runic_roots.arachnid.web_snare.desc: Cast a web: foes within 5 blocks are rooted by Slowness IV and a trap is left underfoot. 35-second cooldown.
gene.runic_roots.astral_elf.ambience.des: The small signs that give this people away.
gene.runic_roots.astral_elf.astral_poise: Take 30% less fall damage. Gain night vision during actual nighttime in dimensions with a normal day/night cycle.
gene.runic_roots.astral_elf.starbound_th: Bind a starbound thread where you stand. Press again within 8s to be pulled back to it. 40-second cooldown.
-3 maximum HP. A fragile tether cannot cross walls, dimensions or distant terrain; plan an escape before danger arrives.
gene.runic_roots.auroran.ambience.desc: The small signs that give this people away.
gene.runic_roots.auroran.dawnward.desc: Ward yourself and up to two allies within 6 blocks and clear sight for 6s. Each ward prevents at most 4 HP after armor and absorption. Racial wards never add together on one hit. 55-second cooldown.
+2 maximum HP and 15% less classified magical damage. A magical projectile uses this affinity.
gene.runic_roots.auroran.mortal_vessel.d: Take 15% more ordinary physical and projectile damage. Armor, shields and cover remain useful; magical projectiles do not also receive this penalty.
gene.runic_roots.avian.ambience.desc: The small signs that give this people away.
gene.runic_roots.avian.hollow_bones.desc: -2 hearts, easily knocked back, and -10% melee damage. A light, hollow frame.
gene.runic_roots.avian.skyborne.desc: Feathered wings for gliding flight, no fall damage, +10% speed, and keen night sight.
gene.runic_roots.avian.wind_burst.desc: Beat your wings for a skyward burst with Slow Falling. 20-second cooldown.
gene.runic_roots.avian.wings.desc: Wings that fold at rest, spread to glide and beat to climb.
A howling squall of snow that blinds, slows and chills everything around.
Burn your own vitality into power: Strength II and Speed I for 8s, Regeneration for 5s. 35-second cooldown.
gene.runic_roots.blood_elf.bloodcraft.de: +10% melee damage and +10% magic damage, and your strikes leech a fifth of the damage dealt. Blood is power.
gene.runic_roots.blood_elf.price_of_powe: -1.5 hearts and -30% natural healing. Power always has its price.
gene.runic_roots.bovine.ambience.desc: The small signs that give this people away.
gene.runic_roots.bovine.heavy_appetite.d: +20% exhaustion and -8% attack speed. A committed charge has little steering; keep food for the journey.
gene.runic_roots.bovine.herd_strength.de: +2 maximum HP and +0.20 knockback resistance. Sprint 10% faster while grounded.
gene.runic_roots.bovine.hornrush.desc: From dry ground, wind up for 0.3s and rush up to 5 blocks. The first legal body collision takes 6 HP physical damage and moderate knockback. Walls, allies and pets stop the rush. Your held weapon adds no damage. 30-second cooldown.
gene.runic_roots.canine.ears.desc: A dog's ears, quick to show every mood.
gene.runic_roots.canine.eyes.desc: Small dark eyes with a bright glint.
gene.runic_roots.canine.howl_of_the_pack: Howl: gain Strength and Speed and mark wounded prey for 10s. 45-second cooldown.
gene.runic_roots.canine.pack_hunter.desc: +12% speed, night vision, +10% melee damage, and at home in the forest.
gene.runic_roots.canine.ravenous.desc: +25% hunger drain and -2 armor. Always hungry, thin of hide.
gene.runic_roots.celeron.ambience.desc: The small signs that give this people away.
gene.runic_roots.celeron.featherweight_f: -2 hearts and you are knocked back further than most.
+12% movement speed and +10% attack speed. The road never tires you.
gene.runic_roots.celeron.messengers_dash: Dash forward with Speed III for 4s. 25-second cooldown.
gene.runic_roots.changeling.ambience.des: The small signs that give this people away.
gene.runic_roots.changeling.hollow_ident: -1 heart and -5% attack damage. With no true self, no strike lands with full conviction.
gene.runic_roots.changeling.manyfaces.de: +10% movement speed and +1 Luck. You wear whatever face the moment needs.
gene.runic_roots.changeling.mirror_shift: Slip away behind a glamour: Invisibility and Speed for 6s. 25-second cooldown.
gene.runic_roots.chelon.ambience.desc: The small signs that give this people away.
gene.runic_roots.chelon.living_shell.des: +3 armor and 10 additional seconds of air before drowning. Normal land life and all ordinary equipment remain available.
gene.runic_roots.chelon.shellfast.desc: Withdraw for up to 5s, preventing 50% of ordinary physical/projectile health damage, with a 12 HP budget. Movement is capped at 20% of walking speed. Attacks, shields, item use, spells and block interaction are suspended. Release and press again to exit. No protection from suffocation, starvation, drowning or bypass damage. 45-second cooldown.
gene.runic_roots.chelon.unhurried.desc: -10% movement speed and -10% attack speed, including outside Shellfast. Choose a safe moment to re-enter a fight.
gene.runic_roots.colossan.ambience.desc: The small signs that give this people away.
gene.runic_roots.colossan.colossal_heave: Prepare one direct melee strike for 5s. At 90% attack charge, the next successful primary hit adds 3 HP of physical damage and moderate knockback. Sweeping hits do not consume or repeat it. 35-second cooldown.
gene.runic_roots.colossan.heavy_limbs.de: -12% attack speed and +15% exhaustion. Time your swings and carry a good meal.
gene.runic_roots.crystal_one.ambience.de: The small signs that give this people away.
gene.runic_roots.crystal_one.faceted_bod: +2 armor and 10% less classified magical damage.
gene.runic_roots.crystal_one.fracture_li: -2 maximum HP and 20% more explosion damage. Magical explosions apply both the magical affinity and explosion penalty; avoid blast centers.
gene.runic_roots.crystal_one.prism_repri: For 6s, counter one accepted magical or projectile hit: prevent 50%, capped at 4 HP after armor and absorption. Preventing at least 1 HP answers a legal attacker within 8 blocks and sight for 2 HP. The counter is spent even without a reply; replies cannot trigger racial retaliation. 40-second cooldown.
gene.runic_roots.dark_elf.ambience.desc: The small signs that give this people away.
gene.runic_roots.dark_elf.children_of_da: Night vision, +10% movement speed, and your strikes hit harder in the dark of night — but falter under the open daytime sky.
gene.runic_roots.dark_elf.shadowmeld.des: Vanish into shadow: Invisibility and Speed II for 6s. 45-second cooldown.
gene.runic_roots.dark_elf.sunlight_sensi: -1 heart and you are sluggish and weaker under direct daylight.
gene.runic_roots.deep_one.deep_dweller.d: Darkvision, +2 armor, immunity to Mining Fatigue, and faster mining underground.
gene.runic_roots.deep_one.sunlight_blind: -5% speed always; under open sky you are slowed and weakened by the glare.
gene.runic_roots.deep_one.tremorsense.de: Read the stone: nearby hostiles are revealed through walls. Best underground. 15-second cooldown.
gene.runic_roots.demon.ambience.desc: The small signs that give this people away.
gene.runic_roots.demon.complexion.desc: The colour of this people's skin or scales.
gene.runic_roots.demon.holy_vulnerabilit: +25% damage from holy magic, +20% damage while in water, and -25% natural healing.
gene.runic_roots.demon.infernal_blood.de: Immune to fire, +15% melee damage, and stronger in the heat.
gene.runic_roots.demon.infernal_wrath.de: Erupt in hellfire: gain Strength II and Fire Resistance while nearby foes are set ablaze and Weakened. 50-second cooldown.
gene.runic_roots.dryad.ambience.desc: The small signs that give this people away.
gene.runic_roots.dryad.kindling.desc: Fire deals triple damage to you. Bark and leaf burn fast.
gene.runic_roots.dryad.one_with_the_grov: Poison immunity, at home in the forest, and you slowly heal in sunlight on the open ground.
gene.runic_roots.dryad.verdant_bloom.des: Burst into bloom: heal yourself with Regeneration while roots slow nearby foes. 45-second cooldown.
gene.runic_roots.dust_drake.sandstorm.de: A whirl of dust that blinds everything around and hides the bearer within it.
gene.runic_roots.faerie.ambience.desc: The small signs that give this people away.
gene.runic_roots.faerie.cold_iron.desc: -2.5 hearts, +20% physical damage taken, and easily knocked from the air. Cold iron is anathema to the fae.
gene.runic_roots.faerie.faerie_bargain.d: Weave an old enchantment: bless yourself with Regeneration and Absorption while cursing nearby foes with Slowness, Blindness, and Levitation. 50-second cooldown.
gene.runic_roots.faerie.pixie_flight.des: Delicate wings for gliding flight, Slow Falling, +15% magic damage, +15% speed, and night vision.
gene.runic_roots.faerie.wings.desc: Wings that fold at rest, spread to glide and beat to climb.
The Draconic lay a clutch of two eggs.
gene.runic_roots.family.draconic_life_cy: The Draconic hatch from eggs and live long, slow lives.
gene.runic_roots.family.dwarven_life_cyc: Dwarves are long-lived and slow to age.
gene.runic_roots.family.elven_life_cycle: Elves grow slowly and live for centuries.
gene.runic_roots.family.faeborne_life_cy: The fae linger long in the mortal world.
gene.runic_roots.family.undead_ageless.d: The dead do not grow older.
gene.runic_roots.family.undead_chronotyp: The dead keep the hours of the night.
gene.runic_roots.family.undead_sterile.d: The dead bear no children; their numbers grow only by those who return.
gene.runic_roots.feline.ambience.desc: The small signs that give this people away.
gene.runic_roots.feline.ears.desc: Cat's ears that flatten, perk and droop with every mood.
gene.runic_roots.feline.hydrophobia.desc: -1.5 hearts and +30% damage taken while in water.
gene.runic_roots.feline.nine_lives.desc: Cheat death once every 15 minutes, landing on your feet. Night vision, +15% attack speed, and no fall damage.
gene.runic_roots.feline.pounce.desc: Leap at your prey with a burst of Strength. 15-second cooldown.
gene.runic_roots.feline.whiskers.desc: Fine white whiskers either side of the muzzle.
gene.runic_roots.fire_drake.ambience.des: The small signs that give this people away.
gene.runic_roots.fire_drake.cold_quenche: +35% cold and water damage taken, +20% hunger drain. Cold and water are your bane.
gene.runic_roots.fire_drake.complexion.d: The colour of this people's scales.
gene.runic_roots.fire_drake.dragonfire_b: Breathe a cone of searing flame that ignites all it touches. 40-second cooldown.
gene.runic_roots.fire_drake.emberscale_h: Immune to fire and lava, +3 armor, +10% melee damage, gliding wings, and stronger in the heat.
gene.runic_roots.fire_drake.eyes.desc: Draconic eyes, all iris and no whites.
gene.runic_roots.fire_drake.horns.desc: Horns or a spined crest; males grow them heavier.
gene.runic_roots.fire_drake.scales.desc: The pattern their scales grow in.
gene.runic_roots.fire_drake.wings.desc: Wings that fold at rest, spread to glide and beat to climb.
gene.runic_roots.forge_one.ambience.desc: The small signs that give this people away.
gene.runic_roots.forge_one.forge_blessin: Call the forge's fire into your body: Strength and Fire Resistance for 10s. 50-second cooldown.
gene.runic_roots.forge_one.ironhand_smit: 50% fire resistance, +2 armor, and +10% melee damage. Worth proven in fire.
gene.runic_roots.forge_one.stone_heavy.d: -10% movement speed and -10% attack speed; you flounder in deep water.
gene.runic_roots.frost_one.ambience.desc: The small signs that give this people away.
gene.runic_roots.frost_one.forged_for_co: +25% fire damage taken and -5% speed. Heat unmakes you.
gene.runic_roots.frost_one.frostborn.des: Immune to freezing, +2 hearts, +1 armor, and at home in the cold.
gene.runic_roots.frost_one.glacial_resol: Dig in against the cold: Resistance II and Fire Resistance for 8s. 55-second cooldown.
gene.runic_roots.geyser_drake.eruption.d: Boiling water bursts up from the ground, scalding and hurling everything close into the air.
gene.runic_roots.grove_elf.ambience.desc: The small signs that give this people away.
gene.runic_roots.grove_elf.canopy_stride: +10% grounded speed in forest-tagged biomes. Tagged berry underbrush does not slow you; sweet berry bush damage is harmless. Leaves and webs still obstruct you.
gene.runic_roots.grove_elf.slender_frame: -3 maximum HP. Choose cover and distance before committing to a shot.
gene.runic_roots.grove_elf.stillleaf_aim: Steady your aim: for 6s your next arrow hits for +20% damage (up to +1 heart) and marks the target with a glow. 35-second cooldown.
gene.runic_roots.high_elf.ambience.desc: The small signs that give this people away.
gene.runic_roots.high_elf.arcane_mastery: +15% magic damage and night vision. Centuries of study made manifest.
Snap up an arcane shield: Absorption II and Resistance I for 5s, weakening nearby foes. 40-second cooldown.
-2 hearts and +15% physical damage taken. Grace bought with fragility.
gene.runic_roots.ice_drake.ambience.desc: The small signs that give this people away.
gene.runic_roots.ice_drake.complexion.de: The colour of this people's scales.
gene.runic_roots.ice_drake.eyes.desc: Draconic eyes, all iris and no whites.
Exhale a cone of killing frost that freezes and slows. 40-second cooldown.
gene.runic_roots.ice_drake.horns.desc: Horns or a spined crest; males grow them heavier.
gene.runic_roots.ice_drake.rimescale_hid: Immune to freezing, +3 armor, gliding wings, and at home in the cold.
gene.runic_roots.ice_drake.scales.desc: The pattern their scales grow in.
gene.runic_roots.ice_drake.thaw.desc: +30% fire damage taken and +20% hunger drain. Flame is your undoing.
gene.runic_roots.ice_drake.wings.desc: Wings that fold at rest, spread to glide and beat to climb.
gene.runic_roots.ice_elf.ambience.desc: The small signs that give this people away.
gene.runic_roots.ice_elf.cold_blooded.de: +25% fire damage taken. Heat is your undoing.
gene.runic_roots.ice_elf.frostbind.desc: Loose a frost nova: foes within 6 blocks are gripped by Slowness III. 40-second cooldown.
gene.runic_roots.ice_elf.winters_child.d: Immune to freezing and +10% magic damage; the cold is your home.
gene.runic_roots.iron_one.ambience.desc: The small signs that give this people away.
gene.runic_roots.iron_one.forged_to_endu: +2 hearts, +3 armor, and strong knockback resistance.
gene.runic_roots.iron_one.heavy_as_the_m: -10% movement speed, -10% attack speed, and -10% magic damage.
gene.runic_roots.iron_one.shield_wall.de: Raise an unbreakable guard: Resistance III and Absorption II for 6s. 45-second cooldown.
gene.runic_roots.kitsune.ambience.desc: The small signs that give this people away.
gene.runic_roots.kitsune.foxfire_illusio: Vanish in foxfire: gain Invisibility and Speed II while nearby foes are blinded and slowed. 40-second cooldown.
gene.runic_roots.kitsune.spirit_of_the_f: +15% magic damage, night vision, and +10% speed.
-2 hearts and +20% damage taken in direct daylight. A spirit-frail body.
gene.runic_roots.magi.ambience.desc: The small signs that give this people away.
gene.runic_roots.magi.arcane_overflow.de: Spend 30 Arcane Reserve to surge: Strength II for 8s, while nearby foes gain Weakness II and glow for 6s. The reserve refills over time. 45-second cooldown.
gene.runic_roots.magi.volatile_vessel.de: -2 hearts and +20% physical damage taken. A frail magical frame.
gene.runic_roots.magi.woven_of_magic.des: +15% magic damage. Your body is suffused with arcane power.
gene.runic_roots.magma_drake.molten_spit: A short spray of molten rock that sets everything in front alight and leaves a pool of burning stone underfoot.
gene.runic_roots.moon_elf.ambience.desc: The small signs that give this people away.
gene.runic_roots.moon_elf.moonlit_veil.d: Draw a veil of moonlight: Invisibility, Slow Falling, and Regeneration for several seconds, healing you. 50-second cooldown.
gene.runic_roots.moon_elf.tidecallers_gr: Water breathing, night vision, and stronger natural healing under the night sky.
-1.5 hearts and -10% magic damage; your power wanes under the daytime sun.
gene.runic_roots.moss_one.ambience.desc: The small signs that give this people away.
gene.runic_roots.moss_one.desiccation.de: Take 25% more fire damage and move 5% slower. Shelter from flame and recover where allies can remain nearby.
gene.runic_roots.moss_one.living_loam.de: +2 armor. Finishing tagged mushroom food adds 1 food point and 1 saturation point, within normal limits; containers and food effects are preserved.
gene.runic_roots.moss_one.mycelial_respi: Create a stationary 3-block recovery patch for 8s. Every 2s, restore 1 HP to yourself and up to two allies in sight. Each cast admits three recipients total, removes Poison once per recipient, and offers at most 4 HP each (6 HP after amplification). Overlapping patches share a recovery interval. 55-second cooldown.
gene.runic_roots.mountain_one.ambience.d: The small signs that give this people away.
gene.runic_roots.mountain_one.bedrock_be: +2 armor. Gain +0.25 knockback resistance while grounded on tagged stone support.
gene.runic_roots.mountain_one.deliberate: -8% movement speed and -8% attack speed. Good footing rewards a deliberate pace.
gene.runic_roots.mountain_one.quarry_rhy: Find the rhythm of the stone: dig 40% faster for 6s. 45-second cooldown.
gene.runic_roots.nightborn.ambience.desc: The small signs that give this people away.
gene.runic_roots.nightborn.complexion.de: The colour of this people's skin or scales.
Hunt for 8s with +10% speed. Up to three 90%-charged primary melee hits feed, at least 1s apart: restore 25% of real health damage, capped at 2 HP per hit and 6 HP per cast before healing modifiers, and 6 HP restored after them. Allies, pets, villagers, undead and tagged inorganic creatures cannot feed you. 45-second cooldown.
gene.runic_roots.nightborn.nocturnal_sen: Poison immunity and night vision in light level 7 or below. Move 15% faster at actual nighttime with at least 12 food points.
gene.runic_roots.nightborn.sun_starved.d: Receive 20% less healing and take 20% more damage in direct sunlight. A helmet, roof, night or rain shields you from direct sun. Normal meals remain useful.
gene.runic_roots.nymph.ambience.desc: The small signs that give this people away.
gene.runic_roots.nymph.bound_to_water.de: -1.5 hearts and +20% fire damage taken; away from water, far from home, you wither.
gene.runic_roots.nymph.sirens_charm.desc: Sing an enthralling charm: nearby foes are Slowed and Weakened while you mend with Regeneration. 45-second cooldown.
Water breathing, +10% magic damage, and at home in and near the water.
gene.runic_roots.primian.ambience.desc: The small signs that give this people away.
gene.runic_roots.primian.boundless_adapt: +1 heart, +1 Luck, +5% movement speed. You adapt to your surroundings, gaining brief speed as you explore new places.
gene.runic_roots.primian.jack_of_all_tra: Master of none: -10% magic damage and -5% melee damage. You hold no elemental affinity.
gene.runic_roots.primian.stroke_of_fortu: Fortune surges: Luck II for 10s, Absorption I and Speed I for 8s. 100-second cooldown.
gene.runic_roots.reaper.complexion.desc: The colour of this people's skin or scales.
gene.runic_roots.reaper.harbinger_of_dea: Wither immunity, night vision and +15% damage. Once every 30 minutes, death refuses you: a killing blow leaves you on 3 hearts with Resistance V and a revealing glow for 30s.
gene.runic_roots.reaper.soul_harvest.des: Sweep your scythe: nearby foes are Withered and revealed while their souls mend you. 40-second cooldown.
gene.runic_roots.reaper.touch_of_the_gra: -2 hearts, -50% natural healing, and weakened in direct sunlight.
gene.runic_roots.reef_drake.coral_ward.d: A crust of living coral that soaks up blows and cuts whoever strikes it.
gene.runic_roots.returned.ambience.desc: The small signs that give this people away.
gene.runic_roots.returned.complexion.des: The colour of this people's skin or scales.
gene.runic_roots.returned.imperfect_retu: Receive 25% less healing. Food and potions work normally at reduced strength; this heritage does not change respawn or Reaper revival.
gene.runic_roots.returned.stubborn_remna: +2 maximum HP and poison immunity. Below half health, gain +0.30 knockback resistance.
gene.runic_roots.returned.unfinished_pur: Designate your latest legal living aggressor from the last 30s, within 16 blocks and sight. For 10s, gain 15% grounded speed while moving toward them; one 90%-charged primary melee hit adds 2 HP. No valid aggressor means no cooldown spent. 40-second cooldown.
gene.runic_roots.runic_one.bound_by_trad: -2 hearts and -10% speed. A scholar, not a warrior.
gene.runic_roots.runic_one.rune_of_wardi: Inscribe a ward of stone: Resistance and Regeneration for you while nearby foes are slowed. 60-second cooldown.
gene.runic_roots.runic_one.runebound.des: +10% magic damage, +2 armor, and +1 Luck for enchanting fortune.
gene.runic_roots.saurian.ambience.desc: The small signs that give this people away.
gene.runic_roots.saurian.cold_blooded.de: Move 5% slower. In tagged cold biomes, attack 15% slower and take 25% more freezing damage. Leather insulation, Fire Resistance, being on fire, or a lit campfire/fire/lava within 2 blocks prevents the cold state.
After staying nearly still for 1s, prepare a 5s ambush. Your next successful primary melee hit at 90% charge adds 3 HP and Slowness I for 2s. You may move freely after arming. 30-second cooldown.
gene.runic_roots.saurian.scaled_survivor: +2 armor and 15 additional seconds of air before drowning. Respiration still helps; this is finite breath, not water breathing.
gene.runic_roots.scaleheir.ambience.desc: The small signs that give this people away.
gene.runic_roots.scaleheir.complexion.de: The colour of this people's scales.
gene.runic_roots.scaleheir.demanding_blo: +20% exhaustion and -8% attack speed. Good meals and measured swings sustain demanding draconic blood.
gene.runic_roots.scaleheir.dominion_roar: Ward yourself for 5s, preventing at most 4 HP after armor and absorption. Up to three threats within 5 blocks and sight receive Weakness I for 3s. No damage, forced targeting or boss control; player control follows server policy. 35-second cooldown.
gene.runic_roots.scaleheir.eyes.desc: Draconic eyes, all iris and no whites.
gene.runic_roots.scaleheir.horns.desc: Horns or a spined crest; males grow them heavier.
gene.runic_roots.scaleheir.inherited_sca: +2 armor and +0.20 knockback resistance. This grounded lineage has no racial flight, breath weapon or elemental immunity.
gene.runic_roots.scaleheir.scales.desc: The pattern their scales grow in.
gene.runic_roots.sea_serpen.ambience.des: The small signs that give this people away.
gene.runic_roots.sea_serpen.complexion.d: The colour of this people's scales.
gene.runic_roots.sea_serpen.eyes.desc: Draconic eyes, all iris and no whites.
gene.runic_roots.sea_serpen.horns.desc: Horns or a spined crest; males grow them heavier.
gene.runic_roots.sea_serpen.landbound_co: -1 heart and +20% fire damage taken; far from water your coils grow sluggish.
gene.runic_roots.sea_serpen.leviathans_g: Water breathing, +3 armor, and supreme power in the open ocean.
gene.runic_roots.sea_serpen.scales.desc: The pattern their scales grow in.
gene.runic_roots.sea_serpen.tidal_breath: Unleash a crushing tide that hurls foes back and drowns them in slowness. 40-second cooldown.
gene.runic_roots.serpen.cold_blooded.des: -1.5 hearts and +25% freezing damage; the cold dulls your blood.
gene.runic_roots.serpen.shed_skin.desc: Slither free: cleanse all harmful effects and gain Invisibility and Speed for 5s. 45-second cooldown.
gene.runic_roots.serpen.venomous_coil.de: Poison immunity, venomous fangs, +10% speed, night vision, and thriving in the heat.
-2 hearts, +25% fall damage, and you take more harm in direct sunlight.
gene.runic_roots.skeleton.complexion.des: The colour of this people's skin or scales.
gene.runic_roots.skeleton.conscript_the_: Raise two skeletal servants to fight at your side for a time. 70-second cooldown.
gene.runic_roots.skeleton.marrow_deep_ai: +10% attack speed, immune to Poison and Hunger, and you need no breath.
gene.runic_roots.sky_one.ambience.desc: The small signs that give this people away.
gene.runic_roots.sky_one.mountain_leap.d: Bound high with Slow Falling and Speed for a safe landing. 20-second cooldown.
gene.runic_roots.sky_one.sure_footed_sen: Immune to fall damage, +1 armor, and swift in the mountains.
-1 heart; enclosed underground you are slowed and take more harm.
gene.runic_roots.sprite.ambience.desc: The small signs that give this people away.
-3 hearts and easily knocked from the air. A wisp of a body.
gene.runic_roots.sprite.gossamer_wings.d: Gossamer wings for gliding flight, Slow Falling, +20% speed, and +10% attack speed.
gene.runic_roots.sprite.phase_shift.desc: Flicker out of danger: blink forward with Invisibility and Speed II. 90-second cooldown.
gene.runic_roots.sprite.wings.desc: Wings that fold at rest, spread to glide and beat to climb.
gene.runic_roots.squall_serpen.charged_w: A crackling wall of storm-water that knocks everything around back and slows them.
gene.runic_roots.steam_drake.scalding_br: Fire and frost meet in the throat: a gout of scalding steam that burns, blinds and leaves everything in front weakened.
gene.runic_roots.storm_wyrm.storm_gust.d: A crack of lightning on a blast of wind that throws everything around back, scorched and marked.
gene.runic_roots.terra_drake.ambience.de: The small signs that give this people away.
The colour of this people's scales.
gene.runic_roots.terra_drake.eyes.desc: Draconic eyes, all iris and no whites.
gene.runic_roots.terra_drake.horns.desc: Horns or a spined crest; males grow them heavier.
gene.runic_roots.terra_drake.ponderous.d: -10% movement speed, -10% attack speed, and +20% hunger drain.
gene.runic_roots.terra_drake.scales.desc: The pattern their scales grow in.
gene.runic_roots.terra_drake.seismic_bre: Breathe the weight of the mountain: foes are battered, slowed, and shaken from cover. 40-second cooldown.
gene.runic_roots.terra_drake.stonescale_: +4 armor, knockback immunity, Mining Fatigue immunity, faster mining, no fall damage, gliding wings, and at home in the mountains.
gene.runic_roots.terra_drake.wings.desc: Wings that fold at rest, spread to glide and beat to climb.
gene.runic_roots.tide_elf.ambience.desc: The small signs that give this people away.
gene.runic_roots.tide_elf.amphibious_gra: Breathe water, swim 20% faster, see clearly underwater, and remove the normal underwater mining penalty. Tool tiers, Aqua Affinity and Mining Fatigue still work normally. Jump to rise; release jump or sneak to descend.
gene.runic_roots.tide_elf.currentstep.de: Travel up to 5 blocks through water over 0.5s, following your aim. On land, take a 2-block grounded step. Solid obstacles stop the movement; the current deals no damage. 25-second cooldown.
gene.runic_roots.tide_elf.drying_gills.d: -2 maximum HP. After 60s out of water or rain, move 8% slower. One second in water, rain exposure, or drinking a potion or water bottle refreshes your gills.
gene.runic_roots.tundra_drake.frozen_gro: The earth around freezes hard: anything that stands on it is held fast and chilled to the bone.
gene.runic_roots.valen.fortitude.desc: +2 hearts, +2 armor, knockback resistance, +10% melee damage, and a sprinting shoulder-check that staggers the first foe you strike.
gene.runic_roots.valen.stalwart_not_swif: -8% movement speed and -8% attack speed. Heavy and deliberate.
gene.runic_roots.valen.unbreakable_stand: Plant yourself: Resistance III, Absorption II, and Slowness I for 6s. 60-second cooldown.
gene.runic_roots.volt_drake.ambience.des: The small signs that give this people away.
gene.runic_roots.volt_drake.complexion.d: The colour of this people's scales.
gene.runic_roots.volt_drake.eyes.desc: Draconic eyes, all iris and no whites.
gene.runic_roots.volt_drake.grounded.des: -1.5 hearts, +25% damage while wet, and weaker when shut away from the open sky.
gene.runic_roots.volt_drake.horns.desc: Horns or a spined crest; males grow them heavier.
gene.runic_roots.volt_drake.lightning_br: Loose a bolt of stormfire that stuns and dazzles. 40-second cooldown.
gene.runic_roots.volt_drake.scales.desc: The pattern their scales grow in.
gene.runic_roots.volt_drake.stormscale_h: Immune to lightning, +2 armor, +15% speed, +10% attack speed, and gliding wings.
gene.runic_roots.volt_drake.wings.desc: Wings that fold at rest, spread to glide and beat to climb.
gene.runic_roots.wailer.ambience.desc: The small signs that give this people away.
gene.runic_roots.wailer.complexion.desc: The colour of this people's skin or scales.
gene.runic_roots.wailer.deathwatch.desc: Poison immunity. Once per second, sense up to three hostile creatures below half health, within 8 blocks and sight, through small owner-only target wisps.
gene.runic_roots.wailer.fraying_spirit.d: -4 maximum HP and 15% more ordinary physical damage taken. Use cover and space during the cry's warning.
gene.runic_roots.wailer.keening_cry.desc: After a visible and audible 0.5s warning, cry into a 6-block cone with a 35-degree half-angle. Up to six threats in sight take 2 HP, Weakness I for 4s and moderate knockback. Move 30% slower during the warning. Bosses resist control; player control requires server permission and has half duration. 40-second cooldown.
gene.runic_roots.wailer.translucence.des: Not wholly here: light passes through.
gene.runic_roots.wildfire_wyrm.wildfire_: A wind-driven lunge that sets alight everything it passes through, leaving flames where it started.
gene.runic_roots.wind_wyrm.ambience.desc: The small signs that give this people away.
gene.runic_roots.wind_wyrm.complexion.de: The colour of this people's scales.
gene.runic_roots.wind_wyrm.eyes.desc: Draconic eyes, all iris and no whites.
gene.runic_roots.wind_wyrm.galeforce_bre: Summon a roaring gale that launches foes skyward as you ride the updraft. 45-second cooldown.
gene.runic_roots.wind_wyrm.horns.desc: Horns or a spined crest; males grow them heavier.
gene.runic_roots.wind_wyrm.scales.desc: The pattern their scales grow in.
gene.runic_roots.wind_wyrm.skylord.desc: The strongest wings of all, Slow Falling, no fall damage, and +15% speed. Born to soar.
gene.runic_roots.wind_wyrm.untethered.de: -2 hearts; shut away underground you are slowed, weakened, and take more harm.
gene.runic_roots.wind_wyrm.wings.desc: Wings that fold at rest, spread to glide and beat to climb.
gene.runic_roots.wraith.ambience.desc: The small signs that give this people away.
gene.runic_roots.wraith.complexion.desc: The colour of this people's skin or scales.
gene.runic_roots.wraith.half_bound.desc: -2.5 hearts, weakened in direct sunlight, and +20% damage from holy magic.
gene.runic_roots.wraith.soul_touched.des: Night vision, no fall damage, and your strikes grow deadlier in the dark of night.
gene.runic_roots.wraith.spectral_phase.d: Turn incorporeal: Invisibility, Resistance, and drifting Speed while you drain a sliver of life from the souls around you. 45-second cooldown.
gene.runic_roots.wraith.translucence.des: Not wholly here: light passes through.
gene.runic_roots.wyvernkin.ambience.desc: The small signs that give this people away.
gene.runic_roots.wyvernkin.complexion.de: The colour of this people's scales.
gene.runic_roots.wyvernkin.exposed_membr: -2 maximum HP and 15% more projectile damage taken. Cover your exposed membranes from arrows and magical projectiles.
gene.runic_roots.wyvernkin.eyes.desc: Draconic eyes, all iris and no whites.
gene.runic_roots.wyvernkin.horns.desc: Horns or a spined crest; males grow them heavier.
gene.runic_roots.wyvernkin.lean_wings.de: Innate gliding wings, +1 armor and 25% less fall damage. No independent powered flap; use terrain and the occasional swoop.
gene.runic_roots.wyvernkin.scales.desc: The pattern their scales grow in.
gene.runic_roots.wyvernkin.venom_swoop.d: Lunge up to 3 blocks from the ground or sweep up to 5 blocks while already gliding. The first legal collision takes 5 HP physical damage and Poison I for 3s. Walls and protected bodies stop you. No weapon damage, repeated contact hits or powered ascent. 35-second cooldown.
gene.runic_roots.wyvernkin.wings.desc: Wings that fold at rest, spread to glide and beat to climb.
gene.runic_roots.zephyr.airborne_essence: Glide on visible air-ribbon wings and take 50% less fall damage. Flap for +0.30 upward velocity every 2s; each flap costs one feather when enabled. Wind Wyrm remains the stronger powered flier.
gene.runic_roots.zephyr.ambience.desc: The small signs that give this people away.
gene.runic_roots.zephyr.crosswind.desc: Redirect yourself horizontally up to 5 blocks over 0.4s. Solid obstacles stop you. Crosswind deals no damage, grants no invulnerability, and cannot launch you upward. 30-second cooldown.
gene.runic_roots.zephyr.scattered_form.d: -4 maximum HP and 1.40 times knockback received. Avoid exposed melee and keep room to recover your direction.
gene.runic_roots.zephyr.wings.desc: Wings that fold at rest, spread to glide and beat to climb.
gene.runic_roots.zombie.ambience.desc: The small signs that give this people away.
gene.runic_roots.zombie.complexion.desc: The colour of this people's skin or scales.
+3 hearts, +1 armor, immune to Poison and Hunger, and hard to knock down.
gene.runic_roots.zombie.sunlight_decay.d: -10% speed and your flesh decays in direct sunlight; you heal slowly.
gene.runic_roots.zombie.undying_hunger.d: Refuse to die: Resistance II, Regeneration, and Strength for 8s. 90-second cooldown.
heritage.runic_roots.blizzard_wyrm.backs: Frost on the wind, Blizzard Wyrms bring the white-out with them.
heritage.runic_roots.dust_drake.backstor: Earth carried on the wind, Dust Drakes wander the dry places.
heritage.runic_roots.geyser_drake.backst: Heat beneath the waves: Geyser Drakes are calm on the surface and boiling below.
heritage.runic_roots.magma_drake.backsto: Fire sunk into stone: Magma Drakes are slow to anger and slower to cool.
heritage.runic_roots.reef_drake.backstor: Stone shaped by the tide, Reef Drakes are as patient as the sea floor.
heritage.runic_roots.squall_serpen.backs: Storm over open water, Squall Serpens crackle when the waves rise.
heritage.runic_roots.steam_drake.backsto: Born where fire meets frost, Steam Drakes run hot and cold at once, wreathed in the vapour of a temper that never settles.
heritage.runic_roots.storm_wyrm.backstor: Lightning riding the gale, Storm Wyrms are never still for long.
heritage.runic_roots.tundra_drake.backst: Ice locked into earth, Tundra Drakes endure what would crack any other.
heritage.runic_roots.wildfire_wyrm.backs: Flame given wings of wind, Wildfire Wyrms spread wherever they go.
lineage.runic_roots.arachnid.backstory: Patient weavers born of silk and shadow who read the world through vibration; venomous, precise, oath-bound.
lineage.runic_roots.astral_elf.backstory: Star-minded wanderers who leave a thread behind each daring step. Their gift remembers a safe beginning, never an unknown destination.
lineage.runic_roots.auroran.backstory: A quiet sunrise lives in these mortal souls. Aurorans shelter their companions with brief, carefully shared light.
lineage.runic_roots.avian.backstory: Proud, sharp-eyed folk of skyborne blood; scouts and storm-watchers bound to wind and song.
lineage.runic_roots.blood_elf.backstory: Proud elves of crimson rites and bloodcraft; relentless survivors who pay power's price in blood.
lineage.runic_roots.bovine.backstory: Strong horned folk who stand together and commit with their whole weight. A Bovine's charge is a promise to follow one path to its end.
lineage.runic_roots.canine.backstory: Loyal, resilient folk of wolf and hound blood; pack-bound hunters and trackers.
lineage.runic_roots.celeron.backstory: Swift, witty wanderers of the messenger god's line; they prize speed, truth, and the open road.
lineage.runic_roots.changeling.backstory: Mysterious shapeshifters who wear faces like masks; spies and infiltrators free to define themselves beyond blood.
lineage.runic_roots.chelon.backstory: Shell-backed folk who know when to step out and when to endure. Their refuge is brief, deliberate, and carried upon their own shoulders.
lineage.runic_roots.colossan.backstory: Giant-descended mortals who measure strength in the weight of a single promise. Their blows arrive slowly, and leave a lasting impression.
lineage.runic_roots.crystal_one.backstor: Gem-attuned dwarves whose composure catches the sharp edge of sorcery. A single ringing answer matters more than a storm of reflections.
lineage.runic_roots.dark_elf.backstory: Secretive masters of shadow and intrigue from moonless caverns; assassins who answer betrayal without mercy.
lineage.runic_roots.deep_one.backstory: Ancient dwarves of the world's lowest halls where sunlight is legend; unmatched miners with darkvision and stubborn will.
lineage.runic_roots.demon.backstory: Fierce infernal beings of cursed realms; horned and burning-eyed masters of fire and forbidden power who seize fate by force.
lineage.runic_roots.dryad.backstory: Graceful forest-born fae bound to grove and root; gentle healers whose wrath is as old and unforgiving as the forest.
lineage.runic_roots.faerie.backstory: Small, magical fae of ancient glades and moonlit flowers; whimsical tricksters whose magic can bless, confuse, protect, or punish.
lineage.runic_roots.feline.backstory: Graceful, instinctive folk of catlike blood; agile night-stalkers whose elegance hides predatory confidence.
lineage.runic_roots.fire_drake.backstory: Drakes of ember and ash whose hearts burn like a forge; their breath is living flame and their scales drink the heat.
lineage.runic_roots.forge_one.backstory: Dwarves born to hammer and heat; master smiths whose work outlasts its maker, proven in fire.
lineage.runic_roots.frost_one.backstory: Hardy dwarves of glacial halls and bitter winds; cold-immune survivors whose hearts burn warm beneath frost.
lineage.runic_roots.grove_elf.backstory: Woodland travelers who learn the wind before drawing a bow. Stillness, a clear sightline, and one patient arrow are their chosen tools.
lineage.runic_roots.high_elf.backstory: Ancient, disciplined masters of arcane tradition; proud keepers of old magic.
lineage.runic_roots.ice_drake.backstory: Pale drakes of glacier and rime; their breath is a killing cold and their scales never thaw.
lineage.runic_roots.ice_elf.backstory: Cold, disciplined elves of glacial halls and northern lights; frost-mages and wardens, patient and steadfast.
lineage.runic_roots.iron_one.backstory: Stern, battle-hardened dwarves of fortress-holds; tough as forged plate, made to stand where others break.
lineage.runic_roots.kitsune.backstory: Clever fox-spirits of enchanted blood; illusionists and wandering sages whose charm and hidden fire grow with age.
lineage.runic_roots.magi.backstory: Humans birthed from raw magic — Primian descendants who survived lethal arcane overexposure; magic flows where blood should.
lineage.runic_roots.moon_elf.backstory: Graceful elves bound to moonlight and tides; seers and silvered spellcasters, gentle yet dangerous beneath the stars.
lineage.runic_roots.moss_one.backstory: Keepers of sheltered mushroom gardens, these dwarves carry the patience of deep roots. A small haven is their answer to a harsh world.
lineage.runic_roots.mountain_one.backsto: Stoneworkers who hear a measured rhythm in the mountains. Their craft is patient excavation, one honest block at a time.
lineage.runic_roots.nightborn.backstory: Nocturnal hunters with a brief and carefully bounded hunger. The living world still offers them ordinary food, friendship, and shelter.
lineage.runic_roots.nymph.backstory: Graceful nature spirits of rivers and springs; charming healers and enchantresses fierce in defense of their waters.
lineage.runic_roots.primian.backstory: The first humans: fortune, charisma, and boundless adaptability incarnate; the world quietly bends toward them.
lineage.runic_roots.reaper.backstory: Grim harbingers touched by death's silence; soul-reaping executioners and solemn guardians of the final passage.
lineage.runic_roots.returned.backstory: People sustained by a purpose left unfinished. The Returned seek the confrontation ahead; they claim no second resurrection or borrowed death-site.
lineage.runic_roots.runic_one.backstory: Dwarves steeped in stone-carved runes; rune-smiths who bind power into steel and stone, keepers of old knowledge.
lineage.runic_roots.saurian.backstory: Watchful scaled survivors who let the world move first. Their patience prepares a close ambush; venom is another bloodline's answer.
lineage.runic_roots.scaleheir.backstory: Grounded heirs to dragonkind, bearing scales and a steady presence. Their lineage needs neither elemental breath nor wings to stand its ground.
lineage.runic_roots.sea_serpen.backstory: Great serpentine drakes of the deep; coiling masters of tide and current whose breath drowns the shore.
lineage.runic_roots.serpen.backstory: Calm, dangerous folk of snake blood; venomous mystics and assassins who strike with the quiet power of the coiled strike.
lineage.runic_roots.skeleton.backstory: Fleshless undead given motion by old oaths; eerie, tireless bonecrafters and unerring archers.
lineage.runic_roots.sky_one.backstory: Proud mountain dwarves of wind-cut citadels above the clouds; sure-footed climbers and sharp-eyed sentries of the heights.
lineage.runic_roots.sprite.backstory: Tiny, lively fae of wild magic and starlight; quick-winged pranksters far more dangerous than they appear.
lineage.runic_roots.terra_drake.backstor: Mountainous drakes of stone and root; their hide is living rock and their breath shatters the earth.
lineage.runic_roots.tide_elf.backstory: Coastal elves at home where sunlight breaks into currents. Their hands work as naturally beneath the water as upon the shore.
lineage.runic_roots.valen.backstory: Valiant, honorable humans of unbending strength — the immovable rock that corners a foe — living in equilibrium with nature.
lineage.runic_roots.volt_drake.backstory: Swift drakes wreathed in storm-light; their breath is the thunderbolt and their wings outrun the gale.
lineage.runic_roots.wailer.backstory: Sorrowful spirits who warn the world before their voices break upon it. Their awareness follows nearby wounded threats, not hidden lives beyond the walls.
lineage.runic_roots.wind_wyrm.backstory: Sinuous sky-wyrms born of the high winds; the freest and most ancient of drakes, riding the jetstreams above the clouds.
lineage.runic_roots.wraith.backstory: Spectral undead shaped by sorrow and vengeance; silent, shadow-bound hunters who drain the soul and haunt forgotten graves.
lineage.runic_roots.wyvernkin.backstory: Lean dragonfolk with hooked wings and a single venomous commitment. They borrow height from the landscape, then spend it on one precise swoop.
lineage.runic_roots.zephyr.backstory: Air spirits gathered into delicate mortal outlines. Their ribbon-like fins catch small currents, preferring precision over a dragon's power.
lineage.runic_roots.zombie.backstory: Undead animated by plague and stubborn refusal to rest; tireless, pain-resistant, and grimly hard to put down.
pack.runic_roots.name: Runic Roots
